x: Segal of the Valley went away with terrific speed but soon tired and Brian Morris passed him like a bomb and finished comfortably ahead of Poly who narrowly beat T.V.H.
He was second to Segal in the semi-final and 4th in the final with 10.5. In the Long Jump Percy Luxon was well below his form to finish 4th with 21ft 9ins. and gained a Southern standard.

Charlie Jones was our highest points scorer, finishing 2nd in the 220 yds. to Segal, who won in the fast time of 22.1 s. He also provided our only win of the day by cleverly taking the 440 yds. in 53.2s.
